lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everyone in the city ran for the canal.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Because it's the one thing it can't cross.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's made of fire. Water puts it out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nora made it over the bridge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her little brother didn't.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Nora? Nora!

lines.speaker: nora
lines.text: Leo! Stay there! I'm coming back!

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Nobody's crossing back, kid!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But Nora never left anything behind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then it figured something out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It can't cross water…

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: but it can fill it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Building by building, it made a bridge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nora looked at the fire truck. Then the hydrants.

lines.speaker: nora
lines.text: Open every hydrant! Flood the plaza!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If it can't cross water…

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: give it nothing but water.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It was trapped. On its own island.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But Leo was on that island too.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So Nora did what she always does.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She went back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Across the bridge it built for itself.

lines.speaker: nora
lines.text: Leo! Jump!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: into the one place it could never follow.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: Hit it! Everything we've got!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the fire went out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By morning, it was just a warm rock in a brand-new lake.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: You came back.

lines.speaker: nora
lines.text: I always come back.
